mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, it is 38 degrees with overcast skies at Verona City Hall. The moon is currently in a Waning Gibbous phase, and while the ISS will pass overhead tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has released candidate information packets for the 2027 Spring Election, which includes details on Aldermanic seats. Additionally, residents are reminded that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15, with the first installment due January 31.
There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, followed by Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow.
In a noteworthy incident on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found in her vehicle and subsequently arrested for O W I.
Culver's is closed for the day, so please plan for a tasty treat tomorrow when they reopen at 10 AM featuring the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day.
